purpose: SD articulated mecha and action pilot redesign

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game cutout animation PARTS atlas, exact 4 columns by 4 rows, square canvas.
Reference image 1: design identity of ASTRAYON (white armor, navy torso, gold V-fin/vents, red chin, cyan sensors). Reference image 2: target SD console mecha sprite proportions and clean cel-shaded raster style ONLY, do not copy its characters or UI.
Create SIXTEEN SEPARATE disconnected mechanical parts of ONE super-deformed ASTRAYON for skeletal animation. Each part centered in its own equal grid cell, generous fully transparent gutters. NO assembled robot, no complete figures. Consistent front-three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT. Stout SD armor, bold dark ink outlines, 3-tone cel shading, crisp pixel-like edges, simplified readable mechanical facets; not photorealistic, not vector shapes. Every limb segment vertical pointing DOWN in its neutral position; circular dark joints at attachment ends. No lettering or grid lines.
Exact grid reading left to right:
ROW 1: [head with large gold V-fin, eyes, face and neck only] [navy chest with white armor gold vents and cyan center, NO head NO arms] [white/red pelvis waist skirt only] [small twin-thruster navy backpack only].
ROW 2: [rear upper arm including white shoulder armor down to elbow joint, no hand] [rear forearm white armor ending in closed dark fist at bottom] [front upper arm including broad white shoulder armor down to elbow joint, no hand] [front forearm white armor ending in closed dark fist at bottom].
ROW 3: [rear short white thigh segment hip-to-knee] [rear bulky white shin with navy boot toe pointing RIGHT] [front short white thigh segment hip-to-knee] [front bulky white shin with navy boot toe pointing RIGHT].
ROW 4: [dark navy beam rifle side view barrel horizontal RIGHT, trigger grip near left third] [white/navy angular shield vertical] [short beam-saber HILT only, vertical barrel UP, no glowing blade] [one narrow white/navy backpack fin vertical].
Each piece a SINGLE coherent cutout, never attach adjacent parts. Arm/leg joints must include overlap material for rotations. Preserve functional weapon and anatomy. Pure alpha transparent background, no shadow, no texture outside parts, no captions or numbers.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 2D game cutout animation PARTS atlas, exact FOUR columns by FOUR rows, square canvas.
Image1 is OBSIDIAN identity (black/graphite armor, red sensors and crimson trim, angular head and spiked wing binders). Image2 is an already generated ASTRAYON parts atlas; match its clean bold SD cel-shaded game sprite medium, same parts order, but draw distinct OBSIDIAN parts. Do not copy characters/UI/text from references.
Create precisely SIXTEEN separate disconnected parts of ONE SD OBSIDIAN robot. Each part completely inside its own equal cell with at least 24px gutters. No assembled robot, no complete figures. All pieces front-three-quarter facing screen RIGHT, including head and boot toes. Neutral limb segments point vertically DOWN. Circular mechanical joints at attachment ends. Stylized raster sprite with thick dark contours and 3-tone cel shading, silver-blue rim highlights to make black armor readable. SD proportions, large angular head, stout compact armor. No photorealistic shading. No writing.
Exact row-major order:
ROW1: head and neck only with red eyes/sharp black crimson crest; graphite chest torso with red core only NO head NO arms; waist/pelvis red-black skirt only; twin-thruster compact backpack.
ROW2: rear upper arm shoulder-to-elbow including shoulderarmor; rear forearm ending closed fist; front upper arm shoulder-to-elbow including spiked shoulderarmor; front forearm ending closed fist.
ROW3: rear short thigh; rear bulky shin including boot toe RIGHT; front short thigh; front bulky shin including boot toe RIGHT.
ROW4: black long beam rifle horizontal barrel RIGHT and triggergrip near leftthird; black/crimson angular vertical shield; short black/crimson beam sword HILT ONLY vertical emitter UP with no blade; one long black/crimson spike BINDER vertical.
Keep every piece fully isolated, even the rifle MUST fit within its cell. Actual transparent alpha background no white, no ground shadows, no labels, no numbers, no lines, no borders.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original full-width 16:9 pilot cockpit action cut-in for a mecha strategy game.
Reference1: the hero pilot identity in the bottom portraits ONLY: young dark-haired man wearing a white/navy flight helmet with transparent visor and a white/navy suit. Reference2: expressive hand-drawn anime cockpit action framing ONLY, not its character identity.
Create a new dramatic cel-animation frame: our helmeted hero leans forward in his cockpit, one white-gloved hand firmly pushing a control lever in the lower foreground, shoulders twisting with the force of his command. Determined brows, wide fierce eyes clearly visible through very clean transparent visor, mouth OPEN mid-battle yell with visible teeth, expressive face not neutral. Face centered at 50% width and 40% height, head large occupying about 45% picture height, waist-up posture and gripping hand visible. Dynamic slight low angle, cockpit harness, navy chair, simplified turquoise-lit control shapes around edges. Strong clean ink contours and flat 3-tone cel shading matching classic hand-drawn console anime cut-ins, saturated but controlled blue/cyan lighting with warm facial highlights. No photorealism, no 3D render, no gritty texture, no motion blur over face. Keep helmet white/navy, remove all logos and insignia. No copy of the other reference's scarf, bare head, or uniform. No text, speech bubbles, UI, numbers, watermark or borders. Original horizontal composition.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original 16:9 anime pilot cockpit ACTION cut-in.
Reference1 identity comes ONLY from the LARGE main PILOT portrait in the middle-right of the sheet: mature light brown / dark blond haired man with a fitted asymmetrical metallic half-face mask over HIS LEFT side, which is the viewer's RIGHT in that portrait; black uniform with crimson lining and gold trim. Do NOT use the lower helmeted portrait or a dark-haired substitute. Reference2 is only expressive hand-drawn cockpit/action style.
Create a NEW cel-animated battle frame of this same masked man in a red-lit cockpit. He grips and pulls a control stick forcefully in the foreground, leans into his command, visible uncovered eye narrowed, mouth open in a fierce shout. His mask remains on HIS LEFT cheek/eye/jaw (viewer-right in near-frontal framing), dark gunmetal fitted plates with a small red eye slit, and the unmasked right side of his face remains visible. Light brown tousled hair, no helmet, clearly older and visually different from hero. Keep head near frontal, gaze slightly toward screen LEFT; do not mirror the character or move mask. Face centered around x50%, y40%, head~45% imageheight, waist-up body, harness and one gripping gloved hand visible. Broad angular cockpit chair and red instrument lights at edges, confident dark lineart, rich flat 3-tone anime cel shading, strong expression, crisp image. No photorealistic rendering, no texture grit, no blur covering face. No text, labels, symbols, insignia, UI, watermark or borders. Landscape16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 side-view battle arena background for a SD 2D cel-sprite mecha strategy game.
A ruined orbital station's broad exterior landing platform, beneath open space and the blue curve of a planet. Camera positioned for a side-view duel, not isometric. Lower 35% a flat broad navy steel platform with subtle panel lines receding horizontally, some small broken plating in foreground corners. The combatants will be composited in the center-left and center-right, so keep center 70% open and readable with no foreground pillars. Horizon at 60% imageheight; distant ruined orbital arches and a broken space ring frame far edges only. Blue planetary atmosphere and deep stars in upper background, soft crimson emergency light at far right. Hand-painted 1990s/2000s anime videogame background with crisp structural outlines, layered cel-shaded colors, restrained texture and depth; clean readable medium-detail art suited to big-headed SD robot sprites, no photorealism, no blurry lens effects. Ground neutral dark blue so white and black/red sprites both readable. No characters, robots, people, weapons, text, logos, UI or frame. Landscape16:9.
